c74object.name: evi_evieve
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_evieve.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_evieve.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_evieve.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
evi_utilities.genexpr
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_cossin.genexpr
evi_tanh.genexpr
evi_trig.genexpr
evi_pade.genexpr
evi_fastskew.genexpr
evi_interp.genexpr
evi_adaa.genexpr
evi_biquads.genexpr
evi_butterworth.genexpr
evi_clipping.genexpr
evi_counting.genexpr
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_dynamics.genexpr
evi_env.genexpr
evi_lfo.genexpr
evi_polyblep.genexpr
evi_ptr.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_saturators.genexpr
evi_sources.genexpr
evi_svfs.genexpr
evi_waveshaping.genexpr
evi_buchla.genexpr
evi_dfm_lib.genexpr
evi_resbank.genexpr
evi_reverb_library.genexpr
evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr

About this File:
Global 'cores' and 'libraries' and 'objects' .genexpr files include. Do not include 'evi_core', 'evi_lib' or 'evi_evieve' together! Only ever use one of these global requires. Note, it is very unlikely you would ever need this require.
